name: jira
description: Jira Cloud — read, search, create, comment on and transition issues through the Jira REST API v3 with curl.

settings.label: Jira site
settings.description: The Atlassian site host, without a scheme — e.g. `mycompany.atlassian.net`. The site's cloud id is looked up from it automatically, so there is nothing else to configure.

settings.label: Account email
settings.description: Email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to. Jira's Basic auth is `email:token`, and everything the agent does happens as this account — its permissions are the plugin's permissions.

secrets.label: API token
secrets.description: An Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Either kind works here: this plugin calls Jira through the api.atlassian.com gateway, which accepts scoped and unscoped (classic) tokens alike. Tokens can carry an expiry date — if calls start failing with 401, check that first.
